scope: Attention-only recorded layer3 QSA: selected positions, query, and main KV pages held immutable. No selector, projections, model state, cache writer, HTTP, or Python replay timing.
timing_scope: CUDA events captured around all attention launches needed for each complete saved workload; consecutive groups share one split workspace. Native driver replay; readbacks and preparation excluded.
padding: Inactive request/query-position/selection entries=-1, inactive queries=0; inactive outputs must be zero.
cache_reconstruction: Recorded physical page IDs are preserved in a compact eight-page pool; every referenced page is validated present. Block-table values and active operands are unchanged.
baseline_policy: Recorded direct512 and split16 must reproduce bitwise before the capacity matrix. Partition comparisons against direct are diagnostic differences, not model-accuracy acceptance.

selection_coverage.limitation: Each tested split count >=16 assigns at most one nonempty tile to a partition. Equality across split counts is not established for longer selections. Capacity invariance is established only on the saved layer3 operands.

partition_differences.split16_vs32_vs64: All output tensor bytes match for every tested workload/capacity; this follows the limited nonempty-tile coverage and is not a general split-count equivalence claim.

merge_source_review.dispatch: serial when capacity > splits, otherwise cooperative
merge_source_review.arithmetic: Both form split pairs s+(s+32), then the same adjacent butterfly stages0..4. Cooperative mapping performs stages0..2 within contiguous groups of8 and combines groups through stages3..4. Max/denominator lane and slot order also match. GPU capacity comparisons cross this branch and are bitwise equal for these operands.

limitations: Attention-only events exclude QSA selection, cache writes, projections, model execution, scheduler, HTTP and preparation.
Capacities1/2/4 represent11savedprefillquery rows partitioned into groups, not independently recorded decode requests.
All supplied main KV values are recorded physical pages0..7; the compact pool contains1MiB of BF16 K/V across two tensors per workload. No long-context/full-selection workload is measured.
Per-case GPU clocks are not sampled or fixed. Both raw repetitions and cross-process repeats are retained; earlytail p10-p90 variation persists.
No independent canonical attention or full-model accuracy gate is run. Split outputs intentionally retain measured differences from the recorded direct path.
No production kernel, dispatch, catalog or installed package was modified.
